question: Which active users have expiring, inactive or revoked permission assignments?

steps.name: assignments
steps.soql: SELECT AssigneeId, Assignee.Username, PermissionSet.Name, PermissionSetGroup.DeveloperName, ExpirationDate, IsActive, IsRevoked FROM PermissionSetAssignment WHERE Assignee.IsActive = true AND (IsActive = false OR IsRevoked = true OR ExpirationDate <= TODAY OR ExpirationDate = NEXT_N_DAYS:{days}) ORDER BY ExpirationDate ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {assignments.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: NEXT_N_DAYS follows Salesforce relative-date boundaries. Dates, query identity and time of export matter.
Inactive or revoked assignments may have no expiration date. Group muting and other grants remain separate.
Empty results are not proof that no access will expire.
